_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Giocadore Serpe in una grìgia {width}×{height}.
Guvernas sa serpe {player_id}. Mòvidos bàlidus: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (o w/s/a/d).
Obietivu: sopravìvere pro su prus longu tempus o èssere su prus longu e otènnere su puntegiu artu (lìmite de voltas {max_turns} voltas).

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} est mortu pro una mossa non vàlida.

outcome.survived_win: Su giogadore {player_id} est subrabìvidu; totu sos àteros sunt mortos.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Totu sos serpentes sunt mortos in su matessi tempus.
outcome.outlived: Su giogadore at subrabìvidu totu sos àteros.
outcome.turn_limit: Limite de curva atzetadu - su prus bonu puntu binchet sa parta.
